description: This file contains the implementation of the CalculatorDisplay class, which provides concrete methods for the ICalcDisplay interface. It manages interactions with the ViewModel components such as setting display text, handling errors, and updating calculator state through callback references.

classes.name: CalculatorDisplay
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the ICalcDisplay interface, responsible for updating the calculator's display and state via callback references.

methods.name: SetCallback
methods.description: Sets the weak reference callback for the main calculator view model.

methods.name: SetHistoryCallback
methods.description: Sets the weak reference callback for the calculator's history view model.

methods.name: SetPrimaryDisplay
methods.description: Updates the primary display with a string value and error state.

methods.name: SetParenthesisNumber
methods.description: Updates the count of open parentheses in the calculator display.

methods.name: OnNoRightParenAdded
methods.description: Notifies that a right parenthesis was not added when expected.

methods.name: SetIsInError
methods.description: Sets the error state of the calculator display.

methods.name: SetExpressionDisplay
methods.description: Updates the expression display with tokens and commands.

methods.name: SetMemorizedNumbers
methods.description: Updates the list of memorized numbers.

methods.name: OnHistoryItemAdded
methods.description: Handles the event when a new history item is added.

methods.name: MaxDigitsReached
methods.description: Handles the event when maximum digit limit is reached.

methods.name: BinaryOperatorReceived
methods.description: Handles the event when a binary operator is received.

methods.name: MemoryItemChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when a memory item is changed.

methods.name: InputChanged
methods.description: Handles the event when input changes occur.
